title: Binary File Reader
text: Read data from binary files, 2 outputs, no direct feedthrough, {Storage data type} sets Storage class of data in file; {File name} sets the name of the file, {File header} sets the size of the header struct, {Export header to base workspace} sets the retrieve the header, {Samples per frame} sets the number of samples per output frame, {Data is complex} sets the data complexity, {Number of channels}, {Output end-of-file indicator} sets the end-of-file indicator, {Sample time (s)} and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: data
ports.summary: Binary file data column vector | row vector | matrix

params.name: File name
params.values: Name of the file ’Untitled.bin’ (default) | character vector

params.name: File header
params.values: Size of the header struct([]) (default) | structure

params.name: Storage data type
params.values: Storage class of data in file ’double’ (default) | ’single’ | ’int8’ | ’int16’ | ’int32’ | ’int64’ | ’uint8’ | ’uint16’ | ’uint32’ | ’uint64’

params.name: Samples per frame
params.values: Number of samples per output frame 1024 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation
